passages.title: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR Captains Guide
passages.heading: HOW TO REGISTER YOUR TEAM (SIGNING UP YOUR TEAM)
passages.section_label: HOW TO REGISTER YOUR TEAM (SIGNING UP YOUR TEAM)
passages.content:
HOW TO REGISTER YOUR TEAM (SIGNING UP YOUR TEAM)
• When registration opens for an upcoming league season, the Club will notify previous Captains and
other Club members that league registration is open.
• Visit the Club’s Leagues page at https://lwrpickleballclub.com/leagues and select the
appropriate league you wish to join.
• On the league registration page, begin the team registration process by clicking Register My Team!
• You must be signed into your regular Club membership account before you can register a team.
• Once you are signed into your Club membership account, select the Quantity and choose 1 to
register one team. If you need to register multiple teams, please complete the registration process
separately for each team.

passages.title: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR Captains Guide
passages.heading: HOW TO REGISTER YOUR TEAM (SIGNING UP YOUR TEAM)
passages.section_label: HOW TO REGISTER YOUR TEAM (SIGNING UP YOUR TEAM)
passages.content:
• Complete all required questions to set up your team. Most of the information you enter, such as
your Team Name, Captain, and other team details, can be changed later. This initial information
will be used to create and activate your team and associate it with the appropriate community and
related league information.
• Once you have completed the registration form, click Register My Team! You will then be prompted
to enter your payment information or, if available, select your current payment method already on
file.
• After completing your registration, you will receive a confirmation email with your team registration
details, important next steps, and upcoming dates and deadlines.
• League Management will then activate your team and assign you and/or the individuals designated
during registration as the Captain and Co-Captain(s). Once this is completed, your initial team
registration and setup will be complete.
• League Management will notify you when team rosters for your league have been unlocked and are
available for you to begin adding and managing your players.
